spans.boundary_evidence: DeallocFile starts at 0x405aa8 after the VSM GetBMBlk return. XRUpdate returns at 0x406042. CMCreateCN starts CMSVCS at 0x406044.

changes.change: Restored the contiguous allocation flag before January 1986. Removed the all-or-nothing free-space check and moved flag setup before the FCB pointer and PEOF save. Revised the D3 API comment and marked its provenance.
changes.evidence: The ROM sets FXVTContig at 0x405b8c, tests D3.B directly at 0x405b90, and sets FXVFContig when D3 is nonzero. It then forms the FCB pointer at 0x405b98.

changes.change: Restored FlushOnly as the truncation option. Preserved D6 for the resource-fork flag, replacing the January 1986 option-byte interface and repeated fork test. Revised the API comments with a reconstruction note.
changes.evidence: The ROM tests FCBRscBit at 0x405dac and saves its result in D6. It tests FlushOnly at 0x405df6 and copies D6 to xkrFkType at 0x405e3e.

changes.change: Removed the October 1986 vector stubs. Restored the word addition before the March 1987 mapping fix.
changes.evidence: MapFBlock at 0x405d1c and XFSearch at 0x405f04 begin by saving their return addresses on A6. The instruction at 0x405d76 is ADD.W D0,D3, which retains the original carry behavior.

changes.change: Preserved the original header, applicable history, and surviving comments. Supplied original equates and external addresses, closed the procedure, and made call addressing and branch sizes explicit.
changes.evidence: All 1436 bytes and 15 recorded labels match. TFLoop uses a short backward branch at 0x405eb2; the XRSearch call at 0x405fc8 uses a word displacement.

verification.method: Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py assembled for the 68000, linked at 0x405aa8, and compared every emitted byte and all recorded labels against the ROM.
limits: The comparison proves emitted bytes and label positions. It does not execute file operations, disk writes, memory handling, or asynchronous operations.
External routines and trap implementations lie outside this span. Their referenced addresses and opcodes are checked here, but their implementations and runtime dispatch are not.

The original Mac Plus source and historical assembler output remain unavailable. Restored expressions and comments explain the verified ROM behavior; they do not establish the exact original spelling.
